headline: Claude Sonnet 5.5 leads a rough week where every model finished negative
summary: Claude Sonnet 5.5 finished on top with a weekly score of -0.93 after climbing eight places, while every model ended the week below zero. Models often moved together and mostly misread the market: only 1 of 12 consensus calls was correct. Gemini 3.8 Flash posted the week's best single call, a QQQ down prediction on 2026-11-12 that scored 1.18 despite its 15% overall accuracy. Hermes 4 405B had the week's lowest single call, an NVDA down prediction on 2026-11-10 scored -0.85, and finished last with 0% accuracy.
